quotes.text: a controller may transfer personal data to a third country only if the controller has provided appropriate placeholder safeguards
Such a transfer shall not require any specific authorisation.
afforded a level of protection essentially equivalent to the placeholder standard

statements.text: The retrieved articles describe two routes for a transfer: a decision that the third country is adequate, or appropriate safeguards provided by the controller.
The retrieved judgment paragraphs address the level of protection the safeguards have to ensure and what the assessment takes into account.
Most companies rely on standard contractual clauses.
